author: legosean10
body:
Creator: legosean10
Map Gametype: Nebula
Teams: Green & Orange
Details: This is a map themed on the future! Each team has access to two iron "stacks", but also has a fair chance at diamonds and other special items in the centre, and other places of the map. There are two monuments for each team, each behind, and to the left and right of the enemy base. At the centre of the map, there is a beacon which provides players with speed 1 while they're on or around it.
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/hho9b17ulkf7ca8/TheFuture-v.1.4.rar

replies.author: TheMasterCow
replies.body:
This was tested quite a while ago, however I feel that it is not up to our standard. It could use room for improvement.

[Denied] - I apologize, but your map has been denied for use on the Avicus Network and will not appear in either repository or rotations. Your map has been denied for the following reasons --
→ Too small. Could you expand the size and extend it?
→ Restricted spawn. Could you add more exits or open it up instead of being trapped into it, which allows for easier spawnblocking/spawnkilling and being lined up into a lane?
→ Diamonds. Do you think the diamonds are necessary, and can be removed to offer more of a fair experience?
→ Monuments. Could they be moved slightly closer or moved elsewhere?
→ Isolation. Could there be more islands/room, instead of a cluster in the middle?
